svg.aria-label: MCP governance, credential-scoped versus passthrough identity. With the LiteLLM MCP proxy, the AI agent knows the user, but the LiteLLM gateway injects service-account credentials, so the user’s identity is dropped: the MCP server and the data source see only the service account and can’t enforce the user’s access rules. With CData Connect AI, the user’s SSO identity is resolved and a trust-level ceiling is enforced on every tool call (low: read, medium: create and update, high: delete), so the identity is preserved and the data source enforces the user’s RBAC, row-level security and field permissions.
